articles.summary: – Funded volume of $748 million increased 24% for the quarter compared to prior year – – $5.24 in basic loss per share or $110 million net loss for the quarter, primarily the result of $125 million in non-cash changes in fair value – – Cash and cash equivalents increased by $33 million during the quarter, to $118 million as of September 30, 2026 – – $0.28 in adjusted earnings per share(1) or $6 million of adjusted net income(1) for the quarter – – $17 million of adjusted EBITDA(1) for the quarter – Finance of America Companies Inc. (“Finance of America” or the “Company”) (NYSE: FOA) , a leading provider of home equity-based financing solutions for a modern retirement, reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter and Year-to-Date 2026 Highlights(2) Funded volume of $748 million for the quarter, representing a 24% increase year over year.
